name: ReelScribe: Video to Text
subtitle: Private on-device captions for videos
shortDescription: Use public captions first, then on-device speech recognition and OCR. Edit timelines and export TXT, SRT or VTT.
fullDescription:
ReelScribe is an offline-first video transcription utility.

Paste a public YouTube or Instagram link, or choose a video or audio file from your phone. ReelScribe checks for public captions first. When captions are unavailable, it can use on-device speech recognition and on-device text recognition for burned-in subtitles.

Features:
• Public captions and timestamped segments
• On-device Whisper transcription
• Speech enhancement and voice activity detection
• On-device OCR for visible subtitles
• Long-media chunking, checkpoints and resume
• Editable transcript and timeline
• TXT, SRT and VTT export
• Device-aware model selection

Privacy:
• Local mode does not upload your video, audio, frames or transcript
• No social passwords, cookies or private tokens
• No advertising tracker in the planned first release
• Downloaded models can be managed and removed

Some public links may not be available anonymously. ReelScribe does not bypass login, private accounts, paywalls, regional restrictions or DRM.
